title: postcopilot-mcp
description: Threads tools for AI — generate viral posts, download videos, export profiles
summary: Threads tools for AI — generate viral posts, download videos, export profiles
offersHint: Threads tools for AI — generate viral posts, download videos, export profiles · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://postcopilot.ai/mcp

toolsPreview.name: postcopilot_generate_post
toolsPreview.description: Generate a viral Threads post using a fine-tuned AI model. Provide a topic or idea and get a ready-to-post caption. Returns the generated text.

toolsPreview.name: postcopilot_download_video
toolsPreview.description: Download a video from a Threads post URL. Returns direct video download URLs (no watermark). The URL must be a Threads post containing a video (e.g. https://www.threads.com/@user/post/ABC123).

toolsPreview.name: postcopilot_export_profile
toolsPreview.description: Export up to 20 recent posts from a Threads user profile. Returns structured post data including text, likes, replies, reposts, and timestamps. Provide a profile URL like https://www.threads.com/@username.

toolsPreview.name: postcopilot_export_followers
toolsPreview.description: Export up to 60 followers from a Threads user profile. Returns usernames, display names, follower counts, and verification status. Provide a profile URL like https://www.threads.com/@username.

toolsPreview.name: postcopilot_export_following
toolsPreview.description: Export up to 60 accounts that a Threads user follows. Returns usernames, display names, follower counts, and verification status. Provide a profile URL like https://www.threads.com/@username.

toolsPreview.name: postcopilot_read_guide
toolsPreview.description: Read a PostCopilot blog post / guide about Threads. Returns the full text content. Use postcopilot://blog/catalog resource first to see available guides, or provide a topic to search.
